t: A small Christian kingdom in the Cantabrian Mountains founded after the Muslim conquest of Iberia, traditionally at Covadonga.
Its kings claimed to restore the Visigothic order, an idea that later fed the Reconquista.
Expansion to the Douro shifted power south, and in 924 the kingdom merged into the Kingdom of León.
dyk: Pelagius’s son and successor Favila was killed by a bear in 739, after only two years as king, according to the Asturian chronicles.
ev: Pelagius defeats a Muslim force at Covadonga
Alfonso II becomes king and makes Oviedo the royal capital
The supposed tomb of Saint James is discovered at Compostela
Santa María del Naranco is consecrated under Ramiro I
Vímara Peres takes Porto, creating the County of Portugal
Coimbra is taken and Alfonso III wins at Polvoraria
Alfonso III is deposed and the realm divided among his sons

f.capital: Cangas de Onís; Pravia; Oviedo from Alfonso II
